// ETHICAL COVENANT

CODE OF CONDUCT

Infinity Hackathon is an inclusive, respectful space dedicated to intellectual exploration, safety, and original engineering.

01

Universal Inclusivity & Respect

Every participant, mentor, judge, and coordinator is treated with supreme respect. Harassment based on gender, sexual orientation, disability, physical appearance, race, or religion is strictly prohibited with zero tolerance.

02

Original Engineering & Attribution

All code and prototypes must be crafted during the 36-hour hackathon window. Open-source libraries, APIs, and starter templates are welcome provided they are disclosed in the project README. Pre-built entire solutions are strictly disqualified.

03

Collaboration & Fair Evaluation

Teams must adhere to fair play. Any attempt to sabotage other squads, tamper with coordinator meal registers, or influence judges outside formal evaluation channels results in immediate expulsion from the campus.

04

Campus & Resource Safety

Participants must take care of college hardware labs, Wi-Fi access points, and dining facilities. Keep noise levels courteous during midnight hours and wear your participant RFID badge at all times.

// KNOWLEDGE VAULT

ABOUT & FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Answers to essential queries regarding team size, entry fees, payment validation, problem statements, and campus logistics.

Teams must consist strictly of 3 or 4 members. The registration fee is ₹390 per member:

  • 3 Members: ₹390 × 3 = ₹1,170 total
  • 4 Members: ₹390 × 4 = ₹1,560 total

This fee covers round-the-clock campus security, high-speed Wi-Fi, official hacker kits, 5 gourmet meals (High Tea, Dinner, Midnight Fuel, Day 2 Breakfast, Lunch), and certificates.

In accordance with hackathon guidelines, problem statements for each of the 6 Infinity Domains will be unlocked 1 to 2 days prior to the hackathon kickoff. Team leaders can log in to their dashboard at any time to view countdowns and select their problem statement once unlocked by organizers.

During registration, pay the exact fee via UPI to infinityhack@okaxis or scan the dynamic QR code. Upload your payment screenshot. Our portal automatically scans the image to identify your 12-digit UTR number and phone number.

Note: Every transaction UTR must be completely unique. However, the same phone number can be used if a college coordinator or faculty mentor is paying on behalf of multiple squads.

Teams undergo 3 milestone reviews with industry judges. To preserve competitive suspense and prevent bias, judges' numerical scores and evaluation rubrics remain strictly confidential and hidden from team leader dashboards. Final rankings are unveiled during the Grand Valedictory Ceremony.

Dedicated air-conditioned rest halls with mattresses, sleeping zones, shower facilities, and gaming lounges are provided inside the campus for all 36 hours. External travel reimbursements are reserved for top finalist teams traveling over 500km.
